description: This file defines a final class 'ParameterRow' that encapsulates a logger data object and manages its selection state within a user interface component.

classes.name: ParameterRow
classes.description: Immutable class wrapping LoggerData with a selection state, providing methods to get and set this state.

methods.name: ParameterRow
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the ParameterRow with a LoggerData object, ensuring it is not null.

methods.name: getLoggerData
methods.description: Returns the LoggerData associated with this ParameterRow.

methods.name: isSelected
methods.description: Returns whether this ParameterRow is selected.

methods.name: setSelected
methods.description: Sets the selection state of this ParameterRow and updates the LoggerData accordingly.
